summary: Add default agent capacity policy contract
description: Implement the orchestration policy mined from Agent Teams AI: default to solo or lead-plus-one-worker, and expand only when task scopes are provably independent or a reviewer lane is explicitly needed. This should reduce bottleneck/context burn without copying AGPL code.
acceptance: Planner/executor policy defaults to solo or lead-plus-one-worker for ambiguous work.
Parallel builders require disjoint modify scopes, explicit independent tasks, or a documented override reason.
Risky broad edits route to a reviewer/critic lane instead of adding more builders.
Regression coverage proves ambiguous overlapping scopes are serialized or review-gated while disjoint scopes may parallelize.

evidence.summary: Implemented capacity policy module and exposed it in auto/go-loop handoff execution_policy.capacity. Evidence: targeted pytest capacity tests 3 passed; full uv pytest 97 passed; make check passed; python3 cli/go.py validate . passed; git diff --check passed; current handoff serializes overlapping broad tasks and allows disjoint scopes.
